items.title: Ask HN: What do you use to review AI-generated code before merging?
items.text: Generated code often misses tests and repeats logic from another module. I wish there was a tool that could audit it like a production-readiness checklist.

items.title: Ask HN: Lightweight alternative to enterprise social listening?
items.text: I am looking for a way to track Hacker News, Reddit, and GitHub discussions where people mention a painful workflow. Existing tools are priced for a company budget and return too much noise.

items.title: Show HN idea: CI logs are too hard to debug
items.text: Every week someone on our team loses an hour to a broken workflow. GitHub Actions logs are noisy, YAML errors are cryptic, and the workaround is manually searching snippets.

items.title: Ask HN: Best way to automate weekly CSV to PDF reports?
items.text: I have a small consulting business and every Friday I export CSVs, reconcile rows in a spreadsheet, and send a report to clients. Would pay for a simple reporting workflow.
